adaptive_read.description: Enable adaptive reading for damaged media.

cache_size.description: Image cache size in MiB during creation.

dao.description: Assume Disc-at-Once (DAO) mode; do not trim end.

driver.description:
Driver for optical drive access: 'sg' or 'cdrom'.
Selects between the sg (SG_IO) driver (default setting) and the older cdrom (CDROM_SEND_PACKET) driver.

ecc_target.description:
Target for RS03: 'image' or 'ecc'.
Specifies whether RS03 should create error correction files or augmented images (default: image). Possible values: image, file.

encoding_algorithm.description:
Encoding algorithm: '', '32bit', '64bit', 'SSE2', or 'AltiVec'.
Affects the speed of generating RS03 error correction data. SSE2/AltiVec auto-selected if supported.

encoding_io_strategy.description:
I/O strategy for RS03: '', 'readwrite', or 'mmap'.
Controls how dvdisaster performs its disk I/O while creating error correction data with RS03.

fill_unreadable.description: Byte value to fill unreadable sectors; -1 to leave unchanged.

ignore_iso_size.description: Ignore ISO size from filesystem and query drive instead.

internal_rereads.description: Internal read retries: -1 uses drive default.

jump.description: Sectors to jump forward after a read error.

method.description:
Error correction method.
Possible values are RS01 and RS02.

methods.description:
List of error correction methods (e.g. ['RS02','RS03']) for --assume mode search.
Possible values are RS02 and RS03.

old_ds_marker.description: Use legacy sector marking compatible with dvdisaster 0.70.

prefetch_sectors.description: Sectors to prefetch during encoding (≈ MiB RAM).

read_raw.description: Read in raw mode when possible (CD only).

redundancy.description:
Error correction redundancy.
Allowed values depend on the method: RS01/RS03 support numeric roots, percentages, MiB, 'normal', 'high'. RS02 supports 'CD', 'DVD', 'DVD9', 'BD', 'BD2', 'BDXL3', numeric sectors, percentages, or roots. RS03 images do not support setting redundancy explicitly.

speed_warning.description: Threshold percent change for speed warning.

spinup_delay.description: Seconds to wait for drive spin-up.

threads.description: Number of threads for RS03 encoding.
